firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently met a vampire takes the first turn as the Super-Vampire. If nobody has met a real vampire, the youngest player starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The other players begin as the sun players. The Super-Vampire role moves clockwise between rounds.
